catalog.players: Dictionary keyed by stable player ID
catalog.teams: Dictionary keyed by stable club ID
catalog.competitions: Dictionary keyed by stable competition ID

master_catalog.clubs: All imported and reference-only club records
master_catalog.national_players: Players included in verified national team packages
master_catalog.league_directory: 100 selected domestic leagues for research priority; not a claim of verified or playable coverage
master_catalog.countries: 211 FIFA country and territory records, each linked to its member association; country codes are aliases where mapped
master_catalog.club_memberships: Season-specific club registration records with source-backed status, competition, division, group and provenance
master_catalog.reference_roster_packages: Reference-only roster snapshots with names and shirt numbers; rights-restricted packages are never playable or merged into canonical player identities

tables.match_results: Dictionary keyed by unique match ID; finalized results only
tables.competition_states: Dictionary keyed by competition stage ID; fixtures and standings snapshots
tables.career_records: Dictionary keyed by career slot ID
tables.audit_log: Bounded append-only event history; newest 2000 entries retained
